import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set the style for the plot
sns.set(style='whitegrid')

# Create a scatter plot comparing megapixels and price, colored by sensor type
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='megapixels', y='price_usd', hue='sensor_type', style='has_video_4k', markers={0: 'o', 1: 'X'}, palette='deep', alpha=0.7)

# Adding titles and labels
plt.title('Price vs Megapixels of Digital Cameras by Sensor Type', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(title='Sensor Type and 4K Video Capability', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
